prescriptive optative enjoining the ritual act

items.question: How should worship be performed using a liṅga fashioned from cremation-ground ash?
premises: Cremation-ground ash serves as material for fashioning a liṅga.
The liṅga is made prior to the act of worship.
Flowers and similar offerings serve as means of worship.
items.inference: Therefore, one should fashion a liṅga from cremation-ground ash and worship it with flowers and other offerings.
items.plain_english: Having made a liṅga from cremation-ground ash, one should worship it with flowers and other offerings.
